# Assembly contrast matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/test-contrast.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Measured 2026-09-08 against WCAG 2.1. Normal text needs 4.5:1, large text and non-text UI need 3:1.

Alpha values are flattened over the page ground of their own theme before measuring, so these are the ratios that reach the eye rather than the ratios the token declares.

## Where each pair appears

- `text-primary` on `surface-page` (normal): Body and headings on the page ground
- `text-primary` on `surface-raised` (normal): Copy inside cards and panels
- `text-primary` on `surface-brand` (normal): Copy on the tinted brand section
- `text-secondary` on `surface-page` (normal): Supporting copy on the page ground
- `text-secondary` on `surface-raised` (normal): Supporting copy inside cards
- `text-muted` on `surface-page` (normal): System labels and metadata
- `text-muted` on `surface-raised` (normal): Table headers and captions
- `text-brand` on `surface-page` (normal): Links and token names
- `text-brand` on `surface-brand` (normal): Links inside a tinted section
- `text-brand` on `surface-raised` (normal): Links inside a card
- `action-primary-fg` on `action-primary` (normal): Label on the primary CTA
- `text-brand` on `surface-page` (ui): Secondary CTA outline against the page
- `border-brand` on `surface-page` (ui): Component outlines, label pills
- `border-subtle` on `surface-page` (ui): Hairlines and table rules
- `focus-ring` on `surface-page` (ui): Focus outline on the page ground
- `focus-ring` on `surface-raised` (ui): Focus outline inside a card
- `accent-ai-fg` on `accent-ai` (normal): Ink label on the bright GenAI fill
- `accent-ai-strong` on `surface-page` (ui): GenAI CTA boundary against the page
